bio: Standing at the grill is a former Japan bantamweight champion. After retiring as a boxer, he took on yakitori as his second ‘ring’. The name Torio stems from his ambition to pursue the 'royal road' of yakitori. However, feeling that the character for 'king' (o) is too arrogant for a challenger, he chose the character 央, meaning 'centre', which shares the same pronunciation, to show his modesty. Precisely skewering each piece of meat is a discipline in itself. Grilling over charcoal also demands split-second judgement. Devoting himself entirely to yakitori, he strives for the pinnacle of his craft.
